note: NOTE: category_id is nature, elemental, or spiritual. A monster drops that category's materials and essence. Combat stats (hp, attack, defense, xp, respawn_s, aggression) are v0 placeholders tuned so a level-appropriate player kills a regular mob in about 3-5 basic skill hits (e.g. Power Strike 140%), bosses take about 1-2 minutes, and a same-level mob deals about 5-10% of player HP per hit after player defense. See combat_formulas for the math and a worked example (level 5 Warrior vs Meadow Boar). aggression: passive = waits to be hit; aggressive = attacks on sight. respawn_s is seconds after a kill, per map timer. Night Stump is the cursed night variant of Old Stump.
